title: Beemar Khoon Rota Hai
body:
Beemar Khoon Rota Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Naizay Pay Hai Baba Ka Sir
Chalta Hai Qaidi Khaak Par
Uthti Nahi Jiski Nazar
Shair-e-Khuda Ka Pota Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Paidal Chala Kufay Talak
Kufay Say Agay Shaam Tak
Har Gaam Woh Zair-e-Falak
Ashkon May Dil Dibota Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Pehnay Hoey Langar Chala
Tauq-o-Salasil Thamta
Durray Hai Koi Marta
Naiza Koi Chubhotaa Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Loota Gaya Sara Chaman
Laash-e-Pidar Hai Bay Kafan
Baybus Khara Hai Bay Watan
Sadmon Say Jaan Khota Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Bolo Phuphi Amma Zara
Mar Kyon Na Jao’on Main Bhala
Bay Dafn Woh Baba Mera
Dasht-e-Bala May Sota Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Beemar Qaidi Bay Khatar
Jehlay Masaib Kis Qadar
Duniya May Kia Insaan Par
Aisa Bhi Zulm Hota Hai
